SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.scrape("{\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"ssrf\":{\"allowlist\":[{\"type\":\"cidr\",\"value\":\"127.0.0.0/8\"}],\"deny_private\":true,\"max_redirects\":5},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
